children: El Pollo Loco’s third-quarter revenue rose 3.9% year over year, while net income declined 6.5%. Higher company-operated comparable sales and new restaurant openings lifted revenue; increased operating and general and administrative expenses weighed on earnings, partly offset by lower interest expense.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: System-wide comparable restaurant sales increased 5.0%; company-operated sales rose 4.4% and franchise-operated sales rose 5.3%.
: Revenue increased 4.6%, driven mainly by a 4.4% rise in comparable restaurant revenue and $1.0 million in sales from three newer restaurants.
: Decreased 3.0%, primarily due to lower franchisee IT pass-through revenue and a prior-year royalty-rate true-up; comparable sales increased 5.3%.
: Restaurant contribution margin was 18.4%, compared with 18.3% in the prior-year quarter; food and paper costs fell to 24.4% of company-operated revenue from 24.7%.
